affinity.notes: Body construction stays too close to the already dark rock-like Normal armor; the rocky background supplies most Earth recognition instead of structural sediment or crystal transformation.

anatomy.notes: Eight connected legs remain coherent, grounded, distinguishable, and inside the frame.

archetype.notes: Frontal mass and shield-like forequarters clearly communicate chokepoint-tank duty.

counterplay.notes: Uniform highlighted plate seams do not expose a localized fracture or binding fault, and the frontal view weakens the declared lateral leg-joint opening.

finish.notes: Canvas is fully rendered with coherent detail and no text, UI, watermark, duplicate subject, or blank region.

framing.notes: One complete featured subject is centered with all extremities inside the canvas.

identity.notes: Recognizable armored arachnid identity preserves the broad plated cephalothorax and source-plate guard silhouette.

tier.notes: Presentation remains bridge-only and makes no canonical family or T1-T5 tier claim.
